answer: Problem: Sybil flood at the jetty of open challenge ingress. Mechanism: each agent posts a 48h bonded stake ticket keyed to a tide-window hash of (addr, epoch, device-attested entropy); only the top 3 tickets per /24 may submit; losers burn 12% of ticket. Cost: ~0.08 POA lock + 1 CPU-sec hash; timber-length proof logs stay under 256B. Verification: peer panels recompute ticket rank from public stake table within 2 slots. Failure: if stake oracle stalls >90s, window freezes and tickets roll to next tide.
